To: 
 
 
 
 
 
   To: 
 
 
Sir(s)/Madam, 
 
Sub: Audio Recording of Earnings Call for the Quarter Ended June 30, 2026. 
 
This is further to our letter dated July 28, 2026, whereby the company announced that the Earnings Call 
for the Quarter Ended June 30, 2026, will be held on August 05, 2026. 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30(6) read with (15b) of Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing 
Obligations and Disclosure Requirements), Regulations 2015, the audio recording of the said earnings 
call is available on our Company’s website. The link for the same is provided below for your 
information: 
 
https://www.avalontec.com/investor/earnings-call-audio/Q1FY27-Earnings-Call.mp3 
 
You are requested to take the above on record. 
 
For Avalon Technologies Limited  
 
 
 
Name of the Person: Mr. Ajay Shukla 
Designation: Company Secretary & Compliance Officer 
M. No: A36992 
Date: August 05, 2026
